decisions.reason: Passenger data transmission has quantified government references, heavy sunk investment and a dedicated page, so it stays central to the firm's aviation security direction.
Post-pandemic demand for travel health data keeps fading, but the dedicated page and its fit with the travel data suite let management still put weak results down to temporary market conditions.
The awareness module costs little to keep within the established training business, though only a passing mention ties the firm to it publicly.
Behaviour analysis is part of the firm's specialist detection identity and its announced innovation path, which justifies continuing despite low visibility.
Passenger profiling draws on long-standing aviation security expertise and sunk development effort, so management persists with it.
The dedicated page and close fit with the document verification capabilities sustain the firm's commitment to the platform.
